_what: The Blackboard paste blocks, as math_assets.py produces them. This file is the CONTRACT between the two implementations of one shape: build/math_assets.py (the authority) and math251/scripts/blackboard/panel.mjs (what the exporter runs). Both sides compare against this, so neither can drift without a test going red, and neither test needs the other repository or a Python interpreter.
_why_a_fixture: The first version of this check shelled out to python3 to import math_assets from a sibling repository. That can only pass on one laptop: the GitHub runner has no python3 and does not check out build/, so npm run check failed, the build never ran, no artifact uploaded, and Pages kept serving the previous commit.
_comparison: Compare trimmed. panel() returns without a trailing newline in Python and with one in JS; that cosmetic difference is not worth encoding, so every consumer trims its own output before comparing.
_regenerate_with: cd build && python3 -c "import json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import math_assets as M; ..."  -- but do not regenerate casually: the point of a golden fixture is that a diff here is a deliberate decision, reviewed, not a silent follow-on from an edit somewhere else.
